SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(SUM(IIF(SEGMENT = 'PREMIUM', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) END AS PREMIUM_PERCENTAGE FROM GASSTATIONS WHERE COUNTRY = 'SLOVAKIA';
